author: Hermann, 1804
summary: 정글과 건조한 삼림 지대에 사는 비둘기이다. 흰 알을 2개 낳아 14일 동안 품고, 깬 새끼를 2주 동안 기른다. 인도 북부와 서부, 티베트 북동부, 중국 남동부, 남인도, 버마, 샴, 인도차이나 남부, 필리핀 북부, 안다만 제도 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: deep wine-red upper back and wings (male)
red fading paler towards the underparts

sexes.male: 머리가 녹회색이고 목에 검은 테가 있으며, 윗등과 날개가 짙은 와인빛 붉은색이다.

art.subject: Red Collared Dove (Streptopelia tranquebarica), adult male: head blue-grey, paler on the forehead and chin; a narrow black half-collar on the hindneck; mantle, scapulars and wing coverts deep wine-red; primaries blackish; rump and uppertail coverts blue-grey; breast and belly pinkish wine-red, fading to whitish under the tail; tail grey with broad white tips to the outer feathers; bill short and black; dark eye; legs dark reddish.
art.pose: perched on a branch, side view
art.scene: dry open woodland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: blue-grey head, narrow black hindneck collar, deep wine-red back and wings with blackish primaries, pinkish-red breast fading paler towards the vent
adult female, side view perched: grey-brown head, brown upperparts and pale buffy-pink underparts without wine-red, same narrow black hindneck collar, blackish primaries
art.build: Small, compact dove, about 23cm, roughly starling length and much smaller than Oriental Turtle Dove, with a small round head, plump body and a fairly short tail for a dove. Bill short and slender, much shorter than the head. Legs short. Tail square-ended; from below the base is blackish and the outer feathers broadly tipped white. Fast, direct flight showing blackish flight feathers against the wine-red (male) or brown (female) coverts.
avoid: Do not make it large, long-tailed and sandy; that is Eurasian Collared Dove (Streptopelia decaocto), which the female resembles.
Do not paint the male's head red or green; it is blue-grey.
Do not paint scaly wing coverts (Oriental Turtle Dove) or a white-spotted neck patch (Spotted Dove).
